snippet.title: Stellar Cafe - Release Date Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Stellar Cafe coming to Meta Quest Dec 11th - Wishlist today: https://metaque.st/4lr5Hnp

The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy, filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, chase their dreams, or be a guest on their podcast. Your voice steers the story.

For more info visit: https://stellarcafe.com
